payload.claim: The stated size estimate (`estimated_lines: 360`, 72 source + 288 tests) prices to 1440 tokens at the repo's fixed 4-tokens-per-line rate, comfortably under the feature ceiling's 80%-block threshold of 2400 tokens even at the documented fallback overrun ratio of 1.4x. The live ledger needed to compute the actual historical overrun ratio `check` would apply was not available in this environment, so the margin could not be fully confirmed, though it appears wide enough not to be at risk.
